title: 10:12 performed his whole work. After the Lord performs his work on Mount Zion and Jerusalem, he will destroy Assyria with fire. In a latter-day context, that work may be the saving of the people of Israel at the Second Coming (Zech. 14:1- 11) and the resurrection of the righteous (D&C 133:56), after which the world will be destroyed.
author: Tina M. Peterson
